description: S51 T2 (TM5), the three-word filter shape of the board: the root plus priority and handedOff (the pointer's THREE states — any, only-handed-off, only-not) ride one request; every word is from the closed set triage.vocabulary answers, and the answer is the FILTERED rows (empty means nothing matches the filter — the filter's answer, never the backlog's). A word outside the sets is refused by name before any read: the board speaks only the vocabulary.
